Conheça mais em: E agora a gente precisa de alguém que faça com que o conteúdo transmita essa mesma mensagem. O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER Você vai ser dono(a) do conteúdo da Adaflow. Ponto. Não é executar briefings dos outros, é construir e rodar a estratégia com autonomia real. Na prática, isso significa: Estratégia e produção de conteúdo orgânico — definir pauta, produzir e distribuir conteúdo para blog, newsletter e redes sociais (LinkedIn, Instagram e o que mais fizer sentido). Cada peça precisa ter uma tese clara, um objetivo definido e uma métrica de sucesso. Conteúdo SEO-driven que converte intenção em tráfego — produzir conteúdo estratégico para blog e páginas, focado em transformar a intenção de busca em tráfego qualificado. Pesquisa de palavras-chave e otimização on-page — desenvolver pautas com base em keyword research, estruturar heading tags com hierarquia clara, otimizar meta-tags, title, description e a estrutura de URL. IA como parte do processo — usar ferramentas de IA para escalar pesquisa, primeiras versões, variações e distribuição. Você decide onde a IA entra e sai, mantendo a qualidade editorial no padrão da marca. Régua de comunicação com clientes — desenhar e operar a comunicação recorrente com a base: e-mail marketing, avisos de obrigações fiscais, atualizações de produto, comunicados importantes. Cadência, segmentação e copy são suas responsabilidades. Apoio direto às vendas e ao marketing — produzir LPs, VSLs e fluxos de ativação junto com Growth. Gestão dos próprios projetos — você organiza prazo, escopo e prioridade no Notion/ClickUp, comunica status sem precisar ser cobrada(o) e entrega com contexto. Guardiã(o) do tom de voz e do posicionamento — garantir que tudo o que sai da Adaflow soe como Adaflow, em qualquer canal. Você define guidelines, revisa o que outras áreas publicam quando faz sentido e protege a consistência da marca. Colaboração real com Branding e Growth — o modelo de gestão compartilhada significa que você participa das decisões estratégicas, traz dados e perspectiva editorial. O problema do time é também seu problema. O QUE A GENTE PROCURA Experiência sólida em conteúdo digital, de ponta a ponta: blog, newsletter e mídias. Curiosidade ativa com IA aplicada à criação de conteúdo: você testa novas ferramentas por conta própria, tem opinião sobre quais usar e pra quê, e está sempre experimentando o que acabou de sair. O stack que essa cadeira costuma rodar passa por: IA e automação de conteúdo (Automarticles, Greatapps, Lovable, Typebot), gestão de projetos (Notion, ClickUp), design (Figma, Canva), SEO (Ahrefs, SEMrush, Surfer), newsletter e e-mail (Substack, Beehiiv, Mailchimp, RD Station), social (Metricool, Buffer) e análise (GA4, Hotjar). Vivência em startup ou scale-up de ritmo acelerado, você sabe o que é prazo apertado e prioridade que muda. title: Cloud Security Engineer Sênior
description:

Estamos presente em 10 países, com 45 escritórios ao redor do mundo. Hoje somos orgulhosamente reconhecidos como uma das maiores empresas de “staffing augmentation” dos Estados Unidos pela Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade. No Brasil, chegamos em 2007 e de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. O que esperar de nós É importante que você saiba que por trás de cada movimento DEXIAN existem cinco valores fundamentais: colaboração, respeito, justiça, comprometimento e engenhosidade. Colaboração, justiça e respeito não são apenas palavras;
comprometimento não é só um pensamento;
e engenhosidade vai além de aspiração. Essas qualidades nos definem em todos os níveis, todas as parcerias e na forma como trabalhamos todos os dias. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco? A DEXIAN do Brasil incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados. Nosso Cliente Esta posição atuará em apoio ao nosso cliente, uma multinacional líder no segmento de cruzeiros marítimos. Key Responsibilities Security: Identity and Access Management (IAM): Strong understanding of IAM roles, policies, and best practices for securing cloud resources. Data Protection: Experience with encryption, key management (e.G., Cloud KMS), and data loss prevention (DLP) services. Compliance: Familiarity with compliance standards and implementing security controls to meet regulatory requirements. HashiCorp Vault: Proficiency in using HashiCorp Vault for secrets management, encryption, and access control. Automation and Scripting: Scripting Languages: Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Bash, and PowerShell for automating tasks and managing cloud resources. Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Experience with IaC tools like Terraform, Cloud Deployment Manager, and Ansible for provisioning and managing infrastructure. HashiCorp Terraform Enterprise: Expertise in using Terraform Enterprise for infrastructure automation, collaboration, and governance. CI/CD Pipelines: Knowledge of continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) tools and practices (e.G., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Cloud Build). DevOps and Monitoring: Containerization: Expertise in containerization technologies (e.G., Docker) and orchestration platforms (e.G., Kubernetes). Monitoring and Logging: Proficiency in monitoring and logging tools (e.G., Stackdriver, Prometheus, Grafana) to ensure the health and performance of cloud environments. Incident Management: Experience with incident response and management tools (e.G., PagerDuty, Opsgenie) to handle and resolve issues promptly. Data and Analytics: Big Data: Knowledge of big data processing and analytics services (e.G., BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc) for handling large-scale data workloads. Machine Learning: Familiarity with machine learning services (e.G., AI Platform, AutoML) and integrating ML models into cloud applications. Data Integration: Experience with data integration and ETL tools (e.G., Cloud Data Fusion, Apache Airflow) for building data pipelines. Cloud Architecture: Design Patterns: Understanding of cloud-native design patterns and best practices for building scalable, resilient, and cost-effective solutions. Microservices: Experience with microservices architecture and related technologies (e.G., Istio, Envoy) for building and managing distributed applications. API Management: Proficiency in API management tools (e.G., Apigee) for designing, securing, and monitoring APIs. Required Qualifications Advenced english is primordial, you'll work with an international team. Cloud Infrastructure: Compute: Proficiency in managing and optimizing virtual machines, containers, and serverless computing on GCP (e.G., Compute Engine, Kubernetes Engine, Cloud Functions). Networking: In-depth knowledge of VPCs, subnets, firewalls, VPNs, and hybrid connectivity solutions (e.G., Cloud Interconnect, Cloud VPN). Storage: Expertise in various storage solutions, including Cloud Storage, Persistent Disks, Filestore, and database services like Cloud SQL, Bigtable, and Firestore. Onde você vai trabalhar? Regime 100% Home Office. Tempo de Projeto: Tempo indeterminado. Contratação CLT + Benefícios Equipe internacional.

title: Analista De Negócios Digitais | Inovação Em Ia
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista De Negócios Digitais | Inovação Em Ia em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a Ionix Ajudamos empresas a construir capacidade interna de IA de verdade. Nada de projeto que acaba na gaveta — a gente constrói processo, capacita o time e fica junto até o cliente andar sozinho. Sobre a vaga Buscamos alguém para atuar junto às áreas de negócio dos nossos clientes, identificando oportunidades e construindo soluções com IA e automação. Você vai ser o profissional que faz acontecer: mapeia processo, entende a dor, monta o protótipo, testa e documenta o aprendizado. Não é consultoria de relatório. É mão na massa. O que você vai fazer Entrar nas áreas, conversar com as pessoas, entender como as coisas funcionam de verdade e onde dói. Transformar essas dores em hipóteses claras:\ "se a gente automatizar X, oresultado deve ser Y\ ". Construir protótipos funcionais usando ferramentas como Lovable e Claude Code. Ciclos curtos de 2-4 semanas. Testar, medir, aprender. Funcionou? Escala. Não funcionou? Documenta o porquê e parte pra próxima. Ensinar as pessoas das áreas enquanto trabalha junto. A ideia é deixar capacidade instalada, não criar dependência. Alimentar o repositório de conhecimento com casos, templates e lições aprendidas. O que você precisa ter 2-4 anos de experiência em funções que misturam tecnologia e negócio: analista de processos, analista de sistemas, consultor de transformação digital, product analyst ou algo parecido. Saber usar ferramentas no-code/low-code. Se você já montou automação em N8N, Make ou Zapier, já prototipou em Lovable e Claude Code Conseguir escrever bons prompts para LLMs e entender o que dá pra fazer (e o que não dá) com IA generativa hoje. Noção de API, banco de dados e integração. Não precisa ser dev, mas precisa conseguir fazer as coisas funcionarem e resolver pepino quando trava. Saber conduzir conversa de discovery: perguntar certo, mapear processo, identificar gargalo, estimar impacto. Comunicação boa. Você vai falar com gente de negócio e gente técnica no mesmo dia. Autonomia. Você vai estar atuando remoto, muitas vezes resolvendo sozinho. Precisa saber tomar decisão. Diferenciais Ter algo pra mostrar. Um projeto pessoal, uma automação que você fez, um protótipo que rodou. Qualquer coisa que prove que você constrói. Experiência com Lean Startup, Design Thinking ou Jobs-to-be-Done. Inglês pra consumir documentação e acompanhar o que está saindo de novo. O que você vai encontrar aqui Projetos de transformação em IA com empresas grandes. Exposição a áreas e setores diferentes — você não fica preso numa caixinha. Mentoria de gente sênior em IA e produto. Ambiente onde o que você constrói vira caso, e o que você aprende vira treinamento pra outros. Trabalho 100% remoto. Processo seletivo Conversa inicial pra entender seu momento. Case prático pra ver como você pensa e resolve problema. Papo final com a liderança.

ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You’ll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage. WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams. Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment. Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process. WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas. O que Buscamos? O Customer Success Architect (CSA) – Infraestrutura do Azure (Armazenamento, Arquivos, Rede) é responsável por orientar os clientes no desenho, na implantação, na operação e na otimização de soluções de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking. Essa função atua como um(a) consultor(a) técnico(a) de confiança, garantindo que os clientes alcancem resultados de negócio e técnicos por meio de uma infraestrutura de nuvem segura, escalável, resiliente e bem governada, alinhada às melhores práticas da Microsoft e ao Cloud Adoption Framework. ✅ Competências e conhecimentos técnicos essenciais Azure Storage – Fundamentos e arquitetura - Arquitetura de contas do Azure Storage e considerações de design - Serviços de armazenamento: Blob Storage, Azure Files, Azure Disks, Queue Storage e Table Storage - Camadas de desempenho e opções de redundância (LRS, ZRS, GRS, GZRS) - Planejamento de capacidade, escalabilidade e otimização de custos - Gerenciamento do ciclo de vida dos dados e estratégias de tiering Azure Files - Arquitetura do Azure Files e protocolos suportados (SMB, NFS) - Integração com Azure Monitor e Azure Network Watcher - Métricas de taxa de transferência, latência, disponibilidade e erros - Monitoramento de contas de armazenamento, compartilhamentos de arquivos e recursos de rede Logs e análises - Integração com Log Analytics Workspace - Análise de logs e métricas usando Kusto Query Language (KQL) - Criação de Workbooks e dashboards para visibilidade da infraestrutura - Monitoramento proativo e insights operacionais ✅ Backup, recuperação e resiliência Proteção de dados e continuidade de negócios - Conceitos de backup e recuperação para Azure Storage e Azure Files - Integração com Azure Backup e Recovery Services Vault - Estratégias de snapshot e validação de restauração - Requisitos de retenção de dados e conformidade Alta disponibilidade e recuperação de desastres - Experiência com cargas de trabalho de escala empresarial ou de missão crítica - Familiaridade com ferramentas de governança e monitoramento do Azure - Fortes habilidades de solução de problemas e relacionamento com o cliente Contratação CLT Trabalho Hibrido (Viagens esporádicas) O que oferecemos? title: Especialista De Conteúdo
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Especialista De Conteúdo em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ESPECIALISTA DE CONTEÚDO 100% remoto Remuneração competitiva, alinhada à experiência e ao nível de contribuição Autonomia real para construir, testar e escalar Cultura direta, colaborativa e orientada à responsabilidade, execução e crescimento SOBRE A ADAFLOW A Adaflow nasceu para simplificar a vida de quem presta serviços no Brasil ou no exterior. Ajudamos profissionais e empresas a abrir CNPJ, emitir notas fiscais e cuidar da rotina contábil, sem perder horas com a prefeitura, cartórios, sistemas confusos e burocracias que tiram energia de quem deveria estar focado em crescer. Combinamos tecnologia, automação e atendimento humano para transformar a contabilidade em uma experiência simples, segura e eficiente. Conheça mais em: E agora a gente precisa de alguém que faça com que o conteúdo transmita essa mesma mensagem. O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER Você vai ser dono(a) do conteúdo da Adaflow. Ponto. Não é executar briefings dos outros, é construir e rodar a estratégia com autonomia real. Na prática, isso significa: Estratégia e produção de conteúdo orgânico — definir pauta, produzir e distribuir conteúdo para blog, newsletter e redes sociais (LinkedIn, Instagram e o que mais fizer sentido). Cada peça precisa ter uma tese clara, um objetivo definido e uma métrica de sucesso. Conteúdo SEO-driven que converte intenção em tráfego — produzir conteúdo estratégico para blog e páginas, focado em transformar a intenção de busca em tráfego qualificado. Pesquisa de palavras-chave e otimização on-page — desenvolver pautas com base em keyword research, estruturar heading tags com hierarquia clara, otimizar meta-tags, title, description e a estrutura de URL. IA como parte do processo — usar ferramentas de IA para escalar pesquisa, primeiras versões, variações e distribuição. Você decide onde a IA entra e sai, mantendo a qualidade editorial no padrão da marca. Régua de comunicação com clientes — desenhar e operar a comunicação recorrente com a base: e-mail marketing, avisos de obrigações fiscais, atualizações de produto, comunicados importantes. Cadência, segmentação e copy são suas responsabilidades. Apoio direto às vendas e ao marketing — produzir LPs, VSLs e fluxos de ativação junto com Growth. Gestão dos próprios projetos — você organiza prazo, escopo e prioridade no Notion/ClickUp, comunica status sem precisar ser cobrada(o) e entrega com contexto. Guardiã(o) do tom de voz e do posicionamento — garantir que tudo o que sai da Adaflow soe como Adaflow, em qualquer canal. Você define guidelines, revisa o que outras áreas publicam quando faz sentido e protege a consistência da marca. Colaboração real com Branding e Growth — o modelo de gestão compartilhada significa que você participa das decisões estratégicas, traz dados e perspectiva editorial. O problema do time é também seu problema. O QUE A GENTE PROCURA Experiência sólida em conteúdo digital, de ponta a ponta: blog, newsletter e mídias. Curiosidade ativa com IA aplicada à criação de conteúdo: você testa novas ferramentas por conta própria, tem opinião sobre quais usar e pra quê, e está sempre experimentando o que acabou de sair. Repertório de ferramentas é parte do jogo. O stack que essa cadeira costuma rodar passa por: IA e automação de conteúdo (Automarticles, Greatapps, Lovable, Typebot), gestão de projetos (Notion, ClickUp), design (Figma, Canva), SEO (Ahrefs, SEMrush, Surfer), newsletter e e-mail (Substack, Beehiiv, Mailchimp, RD Station), social (Metricool, Buffer) e análise (GA4, Hotjar). Não precisa ter rodado todas, precisa ter repertório e saber escolher a ferramenta certa pro problema certo. Escrita excelente, com repertório para transitar entre formatos e tons sem perder a voz da marca. Capacidade de tocar projeto sozinho(a). Visão analítica: você precisa considerar CAC, engajamento, tráfego orgânico e conversão como parte do seu trabalho. Comunicação direta, pública e clara. DIFERENCIAIS Automação de marketing e CRM. Vivência em startup ou scale-up de ritmo acelerado, você sabe o que é prazo apertado e prioridade que muda. NEM TODO MUNDO FOI FEITO PARA ESSE RITMO Se você quer um lugar onde alguém te diz exatamente o que escrever, precisa de reuniões intermináveis para tomar decisões ou prefere distribuir responsabilidade do que ser dono do resultado, existem boas empresas pra isso. Essa não é uma delas. Mas se você quer construir a comunicação de uma empresa de tecnologia que está reinventando a contabilidade do Brasil, com automação de ponta, evoluir com gente que coloca a régua pra cima e ter ownership real do que produz, então queremos conhecer você! title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Information Technology Manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Role Overview Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration. Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes. Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations. Automation, Integration & AI Implementation Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.G., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript). Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks. Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software. IT Administration & Security Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365). Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access. Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security. Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl. Required Qualifications & Skills Technical Experience: 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration. Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment. Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures. High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.G., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting. Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows. Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols. Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies: Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity. Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving;
ability to identify theroot causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms. Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution;
capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions. Benefits & Compensation Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

Garantir a proteção e a disponibilidade das informações corporativas por meio de políticas robustas de segurança, mitigando riscos e assegurando a continuidade do negócio. Atuar de forma estratégica em projetos, integrando a segurança desde a concepção e fortalecendo a cultura organizacional. Promover a conscientização dos colaboradores, acompanhar tendências e aplicar soluções inovadoras para manter a conformidade e a resiliência digital. Além disso, liderar a gestão eficiente de recursos, negociar com parceiros e desenvolver uma equipe de alta performance, orientada a resultados e inovação contínua. Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente! Gestão de ambiente complexo: Proteção de milhares de usuários, ativos, sistemas, sites e operações críticas 24x7, incluindo unidades e parceiros. Segurança de parceiros: Garantia de acessos seguros e operação contínua para laboratórios e stakeholders externos. Gestão de incidentes: Monitoramento contínuo e resposta eficaz a incidentes de segurança, minimizando impactos operacionais. Gestão de vulnerabilidades: Redução de riscos por meio de atualização de patches, correção de falhas e fortalecimento da infraestrutura. title: Technical Product Owner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Product Owner em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world's largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti's Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti's award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data. Syniti's cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‐driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the "engine room" of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‐level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‐native, AI‐driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the "Golden Record" through seamless end‐to‐end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You'll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‐class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‐functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define "What Good Looks Like." Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‐world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage. WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance "plumbing." Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‐zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams. Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‐matching or data‐cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‐moving environment. Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don't know they have. Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action - Be the first. Don't wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process. WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won't stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone's work is seen, and ideas are valued. OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we're committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we're dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we're here to support you.

What You’ll Be Doing: Collections & Cash Application: - Performs daily collection activities on overdue customer accounts through outbound calls, emails, and correspondence following established dunning schedules and escalation protocols.

documents dispute details and resolution actions in the XERO/Salesforce system.

tracks compliance withagreed terms and escalates non-performing arrangements to the FP&A Manager.

investigates and resolves unapplied cash, short payments, and overpayments.

prepares supporting documentation for bad debt provisions. Credit Analysis & Risk Management: - Performs credit reviews for new and existing customers by analyzing financial statements, credit reports, trade references, and payment history;
recommends credit limits and payment terms.
- Monitors customer credit exposure and concentration risk;
flags accounts exceeding approved credit limits or exhibiting deteriorating payment behavior.
- Maintains accurate customer credit files and ensures compliance with internal credit policies and approval hierarchies. Reporting & Analysis: - Prepares weekly and monthly collection status reports, aging summaries, DSO analysis, and cash collection forecasts for management review.

- Assists with ad-hoc analysis and special projects as directed by the FP&A Manager or Senior FP&A Analyst. What We’re Looking For: - B.A/B.S. Degree - Accounting or Business Administration;
- 2+ years accountingand/or finance experience, with prior/current internship in accounting;

- Advanced Excelskills. Experience with macros/VBA is a plus;
- Based anywherein Brazil - Capable of writing and reading in both English and Spanish - Experience with tech company, preferably Enterprise Saas, is a plus. Job Details: - Gross Salary: R$110,500/year - Working Hours: 8:00am - 5:00pm (GMT-3) In addition to a rewarding job that that will directly impact how millions of students learn English, working here, you’ll enjoy: - Competitive salary (base/commission/bonus/equity) - Great benefits: medical insurance, cell phone & wifi reimbursement, home office & wellness budget, team events - Remote friendly work policies - Professional development budget - Language classes w/ Voxy & Fluentify - Work with an awesome international team of super bright, creative, talented, and passionate individuals based around the world - Time Zones: ET(Eastern Time), BRT(Brasilia Time), SAMT(Samara Standard Time), Central European Time (CET) We believe in a workplace that is meant for everyone. our goal is to assemblea diverse team that will help us be leaders in our market. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo. Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position. Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Engenheiro De Dados - Júnior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro De Dados - Júnior em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui. Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos. Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado. Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel? Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados. Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar e disponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelas Delta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança de dados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções de pipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz e propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
Documentar pipelines,regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
Colaborar com analistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas. Para esta vaga, é essencial: Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
Conhecimentoprático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
Familiaridade com pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
Conhecimentoem Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
Capacidade de investigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado. Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento). Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança). Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados). Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions). Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas). Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos). Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards). Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio). Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

Ciclos curtos de 2-4 semanas. Testar, medir, aprender. Funcionou? Escala. Não funcionou? Documenta o porquê e parte pra próxima. Ensinar as pessoas das áreas enquanto trabalha junto. A ideia é deixar capacidade instalada, não criar dependência. Alimentar o repositório de conhecimento com casos, templates e lições aprendidas. O que você precisa ter 2-4 anos de experiência em funções que misturam tecnologia e negócio: analista de processos, analista de sistemas, consultor de transformação digital, product analyst ou algo parecido. Saber usar ferramentas no-code/low-code. Se você já montou automação em N8N, Make ou Zapier, já prototipou em Lovable e Claude Code Conseguir escrever bons prompts para LLMs e entender o que dá pra fazer (e o que não dá) com IA generativa hoje. Noção de API, banco de dados e integração. Não precisa ser dev, mas precisa conseguir fazer as coisas funcionarem e resolver pepino quando trava. Saber conduzir conversa de discovery: perguntar certo, mapear processo, identificar gargalo, estimar impacto. Comunicação boa. Você vai falar com gente de negócio e gente técnica no mesmo dia. Autonomia. Você vai estar atuando remoto, muitas vezes resolvendo sozinho. Precisa saber tomar decisão. Diferenciais Ter algo pra mostrar. Um projeto pessoal, uma automação que você fez, um protótipo que rodou. Qualquer coisa que prove que você constrói. Experiência com Lean Startup, Design Thinking ou Jobs-to-be-Done. Inglês pra consumir documentação e acompanhar o que está saindo de novo. O que você vai encontrar aqui Projetos de transformação em IA com empresas grandes. Exposição a áreas e setores diferentes — você não fica preso numa caixinha. Mentoria de gente sênior em IA e produto. Ambiente onde o que você constrói vira caso, e o que você aprende vira treinamento pra outros. Trabalho 100% remoto. Processo seletivo Conversa inicial pra entender seu momento. Case prático pra ver como você pensa e resolve problema. Papo final com a liderança.

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Product Owner em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data. Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You’ll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage. WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams. Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment. Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process. WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued. OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Ai Development Orchestrator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai Development Orchestrator em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Job Overview: We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications. Key Responsibilities: Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals. Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance. Domain Tracks: You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the followin g;
expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus. Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems. Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design. Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry. Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification. Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design. Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference. Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads. Civil / Structural Engineering — structural member and connection design, foundation design, seismic/wind loading, geotechnical design. Nuclear / Energy — reactor core design, shielding, thermal-hydraulics, renewable energy system sizing, grid-scale storage design. Systems Engineering — system architecture trade studies, requirements decomposition, interface design, multi-subsystem integration. Robotics — kinematic/dynamic design, motion planning, actuator and sensor selection, mechatronic system integration. Required Qualifications: Master’s or PhD in a relevant engineering/applied science field. 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience, producing validated designs from competing specs (not just analysis). Proficient in at least one open-source simulation tool relevant to the domain. Strong Python (or equivalent) scripting skills. High attention to detail across units, boundary conditions, convergence, and physical realism. Offer Details: Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. Engagement type: Contractor Evaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements. After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile. Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo. Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position. Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Product Owner em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data. Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You’ll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage. WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams. Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment. Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process. WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued. OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.
